description: Search individual rooftop-PV detections by département, commune (INSEE code), estimated capacity range, and/or cross-validation confidence (min_vintages, cross_validated). Returns a bounded list of detection records plus a quality_summary for the returned sample (use get_detections_in_bbox instead for map/spatial queries with geometry). Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.

cross_validated.description: Alias of quality_filter, kept for backward compatibility.

false_positive_status.description: flagged = false_positive is true; not_flagged = false_positive is false; unrecorded = false_positive is null (no status recorded — NOT a confirmed true positive).

has_frpv_proba.description: true = only detections that have an FRPV comparison (frpv_proba not null); false = only those without one. A null frpv_proba means "no comparison available", not probability 0.

has_rnb_id.description: true = only detections matched to an RNB building identifier (rnb_id not null); false = only detections without one.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 200).

max_azimuth.description: Maximum estimated azimuth, degrees clockwise from true north (180 = south).

max_first_seen.description: Upper bound on first_seen imagery year.

max_kwp.description: Maximum estimated installed capacity, in kWp.

max_last_seen.description: Upper bound on last_seen imagery year.

max_surface.description: Maximum estimated PV array area, in m².

max_tilt.description: Maximum estimated tilt from horizontal, in degrees.

max_vintages.description: Maximum number of imagery vintages (e.g. 1 = seen in a single year only).

min_azimuth.description: Minimum estimated azimuth, degrees clockwise from true north (180 = south).

min_first_seen.description: Earliest imagery year of first detection, lower bound (e.g. 2018). Not an installation date.

min_frpv_proba.description: Minimum frpv_proba. The data contract recommends 0.1 as a precision/recall trade-off. Note: detections with a null frpv_proba (no FRPV comparison available) are excluded when this is set; null does not mean probability 0.

min_kwp.description: Minimum estimated installed capacity, in kWp.

min_last_seen.description: Lower bound on last_seen imagery year.

min_surface.description: Minimum estimated PV array area, in m².

min_tilt.description: Minimum estimated tilt from horizontal, in degrees.

min_vintages.description: Minimum number of distinct imagery vintages (years) the installation was independently detected in. Use 2+ as a persistence/confidence signal, since a one-off detection in a single vintage is more likely to be a transient artifact.

quality_filter.description: If true, only include detections identified by 2 OR MORE sources(the `sources` field lists at least two codes, e.g. "0,1" = DeepPVMapper pipeline + FRPV reference, "0,2" = pipeline + OpenStreetMap). Default false: all detections are included, including those found by a single source (typically the automated pipeline alone).

sources_include.description: Only include detections present in ALL of these sources. Accepts names or codes, case-insensitive: dpvm/deeppvmapper/kasmi (0), frpv/thebault (1), osm/openstreetmap (2), manual/annotation (3), recall (4). Examples: ["osm"] = detections that are in OpenStreetMap; ["dpvm","frpv"] = present in both DeepPVMapper and FRPV. See get_source_reference for what each source is and where it comes from.

name: search_detections
